mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, input_detail_id, start_time, end_time, status, error_message, task_type
mapper.select: SELECT systemCode, nextLevelId, cfgInputId, update_time AS latestUpdateTime, status FROM ( SELECT dbs.code AS systemCode, dit.next_level_id AS nextLevelId, dit.cfg_input_id AS cfgInputId, dit.update_time, dit.status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY dbs.code, dit.next_level_id, dit.cfg_input_id ORDER BY dit.update_time DESC ) AS row_num FROM dmp_input_task AS dit INNER JOIN dmp_cfg_input AS dci ON dci.ID = dit.cfg_input_id INNER JOIN dmp_basic_system AS dbs ON dbs.ID = dci.system_id WHERE dit.is_deleted = FALSE AND dci.is_deleted = FALSE AND dbs.is_deleted = FALSE AND dci.code IN ('product') AND dit.next_level_id IN ('') AND dbs.code ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['goodcang']) ) AS latest_records WHERE row_num = 1
